headline: Fincantieri Wins €500 Million Navy Contract, Shares Rise 6%
summary: Fincantieri shares rose 6% after the company secured a €500 million naval contract.
why: Fincantieri is a major global shipbuilding enterprise; substantial military and naval orders directly bolster its future revenue backlog.

impacts.name: Fincantieri SpA
impacts.why: Winning a major €500 million contract directly increases the company's order book and equity value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted positively to the significant financial boost and revenue visibility provided by the new multi-million euro naval order.
